name: ARENA4B-REC-OLDEST-FIRST
old: .sort((x, y) => y.at - x.at || y.src - x.src || y.k - x.k)
new: .sort((x, y) => x.at - y.at || x.src - y.src || x.k - y.k)

name: ARENA4B-REC-DRAW-LOST
old: const won = r.result === 2 ? null : r.result === side;

name: ARENA4B-REC-UNRATED-SCORED
old: points: rated && won === true && banner ? ARENA_TEAM_POINTS.pvp : 0,

name: ARENA4B-REC-OPPONENT-ID
old: recent: records.recent.map((b) => (b.opponent ? { ...b, opponent: names.get(b.opponent) ?? { name: '', title: null, glyphs: [] } } : b)),

name: ARENA4B-REC-DRAW-WON
old: (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (a = ?1 AND result = 0) OR (b = ?1 AND result = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM arena_pvp WHERE a = ?1 OR b = ?1) AS vw,
new: (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (a = ?1 AND result = 0) OR (b = ?1 AND result = 1) OR result = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM arena_pvp WHERE a = ?1 OR b = ?1) AS vw,

name: ARENA4B-REC-RUN-ONE-TABLE
old: UNION ALL SELECT at, 1, rowid, CASE WHEN (a = ?1 AND result = 0) OR (b = ?1 AND result = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM arena_pvp WHERE a = ?1 OR b = ?1),
new: UNION ALL SELECT at, 1, rowid, 1 FROM arena_pvp WHERE 0),

name: ARENA4B-REC-RUN-UNORDERED
old: OVER (ORDER BY at, src, k ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
new: OVER (ORDER BY src, at, k ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
